observation: Fifty-five loose solids in the opening setup, with the four bank dashes widened to 1.6 mm since the previous round. Top: twenty-four lane tiles fan from the hub to one clean outer circle, tones alternating light and dark, a constant thin orange margin at every one of the twenty-four boundaries, and no notch, bay or scallop in any tile end; thirty teardrop counters sit two, five, three and five to a lane on the correct points, each inside its own lane and clear of its neighbours. The rim is forty-eight separate curled flames standing off an unbroken disc edge, with open background in every valley and no closed loop, arch, ribbon or handle anywhere. Iso: every tile is seated in its pocket and stands slightly proud, the centre bar is the highest part of the board, the four hub dashes are visible at the bank boundaries. Front: one flat board 6.2 mm tall with counters resting on the tile tops. Nothing floats, nothing interpenetrates, and no part is missing, extra, oversized or misplaced.
